title: 1RB1RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_1RC---: a crossing rule for runs of 2s, and halting needs a lost race, in Lean
text: In this sister of 1RB0RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_0LC--- the collisions and the one-unit anomaly cross a run of gaps of 2 two gaps at a time, writing a block of 5 for each pair, so the symbolic case split never closed. Split by parity instead, with one pair crossed by a shift rule, the irregular steps become 78 general Lean rules and a closed-form macro map; the race invariant carries over, and Lean proves the machine never halts unless a race is lost.
